title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. Reported by phmuni (highball-db#122, 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-19): on an Apple M5, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, Highball 0.9.23, the game crashed right after the Bethesda logo on DXMT and on D3DMetal, then booted and ran well on DXVK, stable with occasional early stutters and no visual defects. Not run here. Second report by GCECEditz (highball-db#417, 2026-10-09), Apple M4, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, mode not stated (the page's DXVK applies unless the environment sets its own), rated 4 of 5 after 42 minutes. alexisoules (highball-db#513, 2026-10-16), Apple M1 Max, macOS 26.3, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXVK, DLL overrides xaudio2_7=n,b;xaudio2_6=n,b;x3daudio1_7=n,b, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 5 of 5 after 182 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. SS102306 (highball-db#751, 2026-10-28), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-crossover26.3-r27, DXMT, rated 3 of 5 after 24 minutes: on the MacBook Air's own screen the windowed and borderless picture stayed at the top left without filling the screen, the launcher offered only 800x450, 1280x720 and 1440x810, fullscreen came out zoomed with the menus off screen, and Emulate display mode changes did not help, while fullscreen on an external display worked perfectly.
notes: Use DXVK. One real report on an M5 with macOS 27: DXMT and D3DMetal both crash right after the Bethesda logo, DXVK runs the game well with early stutters that fade as shaders build. Whether DXMT works on other chips is not recorded yet. A second player on an M4 rated it playable after 42 minutes, with a few dropped frames in the opening cutscene and smooth play after it. A three-hour session on DXVK on an M1 Max with the XAudio overrides rated it perfect (highball-db#513).

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes right after the Bethesda logo on DXMT and on D3DMetal (reported on an M5, macOS 27.0, engine r3)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; the same machine runs the game on DXVK
knownIssues.fix: On the game's page under Advanced set the mode to DXVK

knownIssues.symptom: On a MacBook's built-in screen the picture does not fill the screen (windowed and borderless stay at the top left, fullscreen is zoomed with the menus cut off), and the launcher lists only three 16:9 sizes (MacBook Air M4, Wine 11 r27)
knownIssues.fix: play on an external display (the game's display can be chosen in Highball), where fullscreen works. Untested on the built-in screen otherwise
